dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A computation family for a fixed multidimensional plan and real parameter gamma. Its constructor packages gamma >= 0, a common complex input tensor, a floating-point model for every positive epsilon with model parameters epsilon and gamma, and a corresponding run whose input is the common tensor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified family fixes the input, the epsilon-dependent floating models, and all computed runs used in the error numerator. Its existence also implicitly restricts gamma to be nonnegative.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certified m-axis transform plan. It contains m positive-order axis descriptions and certifies that applying the first k exact axis transforms scales the normalized tensor norm by the square root of the product of the first k axis orders, for every k <= m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the axes, exact multidimensional transform, coefficient sum, dimensions, and norm-scaling facts underlying the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The axis projection of a multidimensional plan: plan.axis(i) is the axis description at i in Fin m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies every axis used in the exact transform and in the sum of first-order coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtype of strictly positive real numbers, consisting of real epsilon together with a proof that 0 < epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The final universal quantifier ranges only over positive epsilon; epsilon = 0 and negative epsilon are excluded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certificate of per-axis local forward-error bounds for a computation family. It provides nonnegative local quadratic coefficients, a positive common radius, and the stated local bound for every positive epsilon within that radius and every axis.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target assumes such a certificate as axisBounds. The certificate's constants are hidden, but its existence is the substantive local-error hypothesis from which the global bound is asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an axis and gamma, this is the first-order coefficient of the axis's one-dimensional plan, namely LocalDef022(axis.plan, gamma).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its values are summed over all m axes to form the explicit coefficient of epsilon in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact output tensor obtained by applying the plan's full m-axis exact transform to the family's common input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its normalized norm is the denominator of the relative error and is assumed strictly positive.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For positive epsilon, the pointwise difference between the run's computed output state at index 0 and the exact full transform of the common input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its normalized Euclidean norm is the numerator in the relative forward-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a complex tensor x on all axis indices, the normalized Euclidean norm nu(x) = sqrt(sum_a |x(a)|^2) / sqrt(product_i n_i), where n_i is the order of axis i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures the computed error, exact output, propagated local errors, and intermediate exact quantities. The conclusion bounds nu(error) / nu(exact output).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The common input tensor stored in a computation family.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the input to both the exact transform and every epsilon-dependent computed run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a computation family: it requires gamma >= 0; an input tensor; models indexed by positive epsilon whose epsilon and gamma fields equal the indices; runs under those models; and proofs that every run uses the common input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes all semantic restrictions encoded by the family binder, particularly gamma >= 0 and consistency of epsilon, gamma, and input across runs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection sending a family and positive epsilon to its floating-point model at that epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the primitive arithmetic used by each computed run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection sending a family and positive epsilon to its computation run under the corresponding model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the computed state sequence and hence the computed output and local residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: An axis description consisting of a positive natural order n and a certified one-dimensional transform plan of size n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each axis determines one cyclic coordinate, its dimension, its exact Fourier transform, and its first-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-valued order projection of an axis description.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Axis orders define the product index set, total tensor size, Fourier sums, and norm normalization.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The certified one-dimensional plan projection of an axis description.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the stage data used in the numerical axis operation and the coefficient LocalDef006.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: For axes of orders n_i, the tensor space of functions from the product index set (i : Fin m) -> ZMod(n_i) to the complex numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the common space of inputs, exact outputs, computed states, and errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a multidimensional plan. Besides the axes, it requires nu(F_k x) = sqrt(N_k) nu(x) for all tensors x and all k <= m, where F_k is the first-k-axis exact transform and N_k is the product of the first k axis orders.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes exact-transform norm scaling an encoded property of every admissible plan rather than a conclusion of this target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for axisBounds. It requires numbers c_i >= 0 and r_0 > 0 such that, for every 0 < epsilon <= r_0 and axis i, nu(F_i d_i) <= epsilon B_i(gamma) nu(F_{i+1} z_{i+1}) + c_i epsilon^2, where z_i are computed states and d_i = z_i - T_i z_{i+1}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It precisely encodes the assumed local bounds. The target does not expose c_i or r_0 and instead concludes existence of new global constants.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The partial exact multidimensional transform F_k, recursively defined by F_0(x) = x and F_(k+1)(x) = F_k(T_k x), where T_k is the exact transform along axis k when k < m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At k = m it gives the exact output; at smaller k it propagates local residuals and defines intermediate exact quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every axis order has a NeZero instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits finite cyclic groups and one-dimensional plans to be formed for every axis and confirms that no axis has size zero.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a one-dimensional plan P with stages t and stage radices q_t, B(P,gamma) = sum_t c(q_t,gamma) + (stageCount(P) - 1)(3 + 2 gamma), where c is LocalDef040 and the subtraction is in the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the exact per-axis first-order coefficient appearing in the final sum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The total tensor size N, equal to the product of all axis orders.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square root normalizes every tensor norm used in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The computed output of a run, defined as computedState(0).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the computed tensor subtracted from the exact output in the error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary finite-dimensional complex l2 norm sqrt(sum_a |x(a)|^2) of a tensor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Dividing it by sqrt of the total axis-size product gives LocalDef009.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise subtraction of two complex tensors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines both the global computed-minus-exact error and each local stage residual.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor of an axis description from an order n, a proof 0 < n, and a certified one-dimensional plan of size n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures every target axis has positive size and an associated plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: The theorem that every axis order is strictly positive.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It rules out zero-dimensional cyclic coordinates and ensures positive normalization factors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certified one-dimensional FFT-style plan of positive size n, containing a positive number of stages, stage data whose radices multiply to n, prescribed twiddle-use flags, a final permutation, exactness against the unnormalized DFT, surjectivity of that DFT, and its norm-scaling identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines both the exact and floating axis algorithms and supplies the stage structure used by the explicit first-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The stage projection of a one-dimensional plan, indexed by Fin(stageCount).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its radices enter the coefficient, and its stage operations define exact and numerical one-dimensional transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-valued number of stages in a one-dimensional plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the stage sum and the term (stageCount - 1)(3 + 2 gamma).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The radix projection of a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The radix determines each exact or floating block transform and each c(q,gamma) contribution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The product index type consisting of one residue modulo the corresponding axis order for each i in Fin m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the domain of every multidimensional complex tensor and the finite set over which tensor norms are summed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: A computation trace for a multidimensional plan and floating model, containing an input and m+1 computed states satisfying the numerical axis recurrence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the epsilon-dependent computed output and all intermediate states used in axisBounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: The computed-state sequence of a run, indexed by Fin(m+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: State 0 is the output, state m is the input, and adjacent states define local errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The input tensor projection of a computation run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The family requires this input to equal its common input for every epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: A floating-point primitive model containing positive epsilon, nonnegative gamma, real addition and multiplication, sine and cosine approximations, an input map, and quantified local error representations for the four real arithmetic or trigonometric operations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies every rounded primitive used by the computed transform and encodes the primitive error assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: The epsilon field of a floating-point model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A computation family requires it to equal the positive epsilon indexing that model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The gamma field of a floating-point model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A computation family requires it to equal the common gamma used in all coefficient and trigonometric-error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: The radix contribution c(q,gamma): sqrt(2) if q = 2; 5 if q = 4; and 2 sqrt(q)(q + gamma) otherwise, with natural q cast to the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These exact piecewise constants are summed over every stage of every axis plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the numeral 2 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports interpreting 2 in types such as ENNReal for the l2 norm and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent case splitter on a natural number, choosing a zero branch or successor branch while preserving the tensor argument.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the recursion defining partial exact transforms and contributes no independent restriction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a natural index i, it applies the exact axis transform T_i when i < m and otherwise returns the tensor unchanged.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the single-step operation used in the recursion for LocalDef020.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the numeral 3 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports the real numeral 3 in the explicit coefficient formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every natural m, m+1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports Fin(m+1) state indexing and the literal state index 0.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite-type instance for the product of all finite cyclic axis index sets.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes tensor norm sums and exact Fourier sums finite.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: For k <= m, the product N_k of the orders of axes 0 through k-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square root is the exact norm-scaling factor certified by the multidimensional plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: For run and axis i, the local residual d_i is first formed and then propagated through the first i exact axis transforms, giving F_i(d_i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its normalized norm is the left side of each per-axis assumption in axisBounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: For run and axis i, this is nu(F_(i+1)(z_(i+1))), the normalized norm of state i+1 after the first i+1 exact axis transforms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It multiplies epsilon B_i(gamma) on the right side of each local axis bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor of a one-dimensional plan. It requires positive stage count, radix product n, prescribed twiddle flags, exact equality of the staged algorithm plus final permutation with the unnormalized DFT, DFT surjectivity, and normalized-norm scaling by sqrt(n).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the algorithmic plans certified exact transforms with the norm behavior needed by the multidimensional plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: A stage of a size-n transform, containing a nonzero radix q, nonzero block count b with bq = n, a block-coordinate reindexing equivalence, a permutation, a Boolean twiddle flag, and a twiddle-exponent function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines one exact or floating FFT stage and contributes its radix to the first-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor of a run: the floating input map fixes every input component, state m equals the input, and for each i, state i is obtained by applying the numerical transform for axis i to state i+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact recurrence defining the computed output and guarantees that the represented input is unperturbed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor of a floating model. It requires epsilon > 0 and gamma >= 0; flAdd(a,b) = a(1+theta_a epsilon)+b(1+theta_b epsilon) with both absolute theta values <= 1; flMul(a,b) = ab(1+theta epsilon); flSin(a) = sin(a)+gamma theta epsilon; and flCos(a) = cos(a)+gamma theta epsilon, with each relevant absolute theta <= 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are the precise primitive error assumptions underlying the numerical runs. The input map has no global bound beyond the run-specific requirement that it fixes the actual input.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the numeral 5 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the real constant 5 in c(4,gamma) and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: The local residual d_i = z_i - T_i(z_(i+1)) between the computed state after axis i and the exact axis-i transform of the preceding state.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: After exact propagation by F_i, this is the local error bounded by axisBounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unnormalized exact Fourier transform T_i along axis i: (T_i x)(a) = sum_j chi_(n_i)(j a_i) x(a with coordinate i replaced by j), using the standard additive character.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact per-axis transform in the exact output, run recurrence comparison, and local residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every axis in an axis family, its order is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies finite cyclic-group instances needed by exact Fourier sums.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: An opaque inductive type with two nullary constructors and no data or stated property.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A one-dimensional plan stores an inhabitant, but it imposes no mathematical restriction relevant to the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor of a stage from nonzero radix and block count, their product equality with n, reindexing and permutation equivalences, a twiddle-use Boolean, and a twiddle-exponent function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It guarantees valid nonempty block dimensions and supplies all stage algorithm data.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Boolean useTwiddle projection of a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines whether the exact or floating stage applies its final twiddle factor.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: The complex input-rounding map stored in a floating model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Runs are admissible only when this map fixes each component of the common input; it otherwise has no encoded error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact staged transform obtained by left-folding the exact stage operation over the ordered stage list.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A one-dimensional plan certifies that applying its final permutation to this staged transform equals the exact DFT.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a one-dimensional vector of length n, the normalized norm sqrt(sum_j |x(j)|^2) / sqrt(n).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The one-dimensional plan certifies that its unnormalized DFT scales this norm by sqrt(n).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unnormalized one-dimensional DFT D(x)(k) = sum_j chi_n(jk)x(j), using the standard additive character on ZMod n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the reference exact transform certified by each one-dimensional plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: The action of an index equivalence p on a vector, sending x to the vector i -> x(p(i)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It applies stage or final permutations in exact and numerical transform plans.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: The numerical transform along multidimensional axis i, obtained by applying the axis's numerical one-dimensional plan independently to every slice with other coordinates fixed.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines each transition in the computed-state recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: One nullary constructor of the opaque two-constructor type LocalDef058.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It proves that the marker type is inhabited but contributes no numerical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: The second nullary constructor of the opaque two-constructor type LocalDef058.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes no numerical condition or distinction used by the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm sqrt(sum_j |x(j)|^2) of a complex vector on ZMod n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is divided by sqrt(n) to define the normalized one-dimensional norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: An exact FFT stage: permute the input, convert each output index to block and within-block coordinates, take an unnormalized radix-q Fourier sum in that block, and optionally multiply by a standard-character twiddle factor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its fold is the exact staged algorithm whose equality with the DFT is certified by a plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: The numerical one-dimensional transform defined by folding the model-dependent floating stages and then applying the plan's final index permutation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to slices, it is the numerical axis operation used in every computed run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: The final index permutation projection of a one-dimensional plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is applied after both exact staged and floating staged calculations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: The block-count projection of a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the radix it factors n and defines the stage's block-coordinate index set.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: The index permutation projection of a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permutes stage inputs before exact or floating block transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: The equivalence between block-coordinate pairs Fin(blockCount) x ZMod(radix) and ZMod n stored in a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines how each transform stage partitions and reconstructs indices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twiddle-exponent function of a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: When useTwiddle is true, its value selects the exact or floating twiddle factor at each output index.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: The numerical staged transform obtained by left-folding the floating stage operation over all stages.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the pre-permutation part of the numerical one-dimensional axis algorithm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef078
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sum of squared complex moduli, sum_j |x(j)|^2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square root gives the one-dimensional Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef079
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every stage radix is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits ZMod(radix), finite radix sums, and radix-dependent floating roots to be formed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef080
dependency_coverage.meaning: A floating FFT stage: it performs the stage permutation and reindexing exactly, computes roots using flCos and flSin, multiplies complex numbers using floating real operations, sums real and imaginary parts with the floating summation routine, and optionally applies a floating twiddle multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies the computed arithmetic in each numerical one-dimensional plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef081
dependency_coverage.meaning: Floating complex multiplication: the real part is flAdd(flMul(x.re,y.re), -flMul(x.im,y.im)); the imaginary part is flAdd(flMul(x.re,y.im), flMul(x.im,y.re)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It reduces every numerical complex product to the model's real flAdd and flMul operations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef082
dependency_coverage.meaning: Floating summation of a complex vector: enumerate ZMod q as Fin q and use the recursive floating real sum separately on real and imaginary parts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines each floating radix-block sum in a numerical stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef083
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating complex root associated with j in ZMod q, namely flCos(2 pi val(j)/q) + i flSin(2 pi val(j)/q).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies Fourier and twiddle factors to the floating stage arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef084
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating real addition operation stored in a model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in floating complex multiplication and summation and satisfies the two-perturbation addition model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef085
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating cosine operation stored in a model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes real parts of numerical roots and satisfies an absolute error bound gamma epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef086
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating real multiplication operation stored in a model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in numerical complex multiplication and satisfies a relative error bound epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef087
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating sine operation stored in a model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes imaginary parts of numerical roots and satisfies an absolute error bound gamma epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef088
dependency_coverage.meaning: For j in ZMod q, the real angle 2 pi val(j) / q.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact argument supplied to the floating sine and cosine operations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef089
dependency_coverage.meaning: A recursive floating sum of n reals: it returns 0 for n = 0, the sole value for n = 1, and for larger n combines the recursively summed prefix with the last value using flAdd. Thus the nontrivial additions are left-associated in index order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies the summation order and number of rounded additions in each floating complex block sum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef090
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that n+1 is positive when n = 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an implementation proof used to construct a Fin index in the singleton summation case.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef091
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent natural-number case eliminator for vectors indexed by Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the zero or successor split in the floating summation routine without adding a mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires the second-order coefficient to be nonnegative together with the existence of a positive radius, and requires radius positivity together with the uniform inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation projected from a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For the reals it gives ordinary real division in normalized norms and the relative-error ratio.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It quantifies first a global nonnegative quadratic coefficient and then a positive radius that may depend on that coefficient and prior data.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite type of natural indices 0 through n-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes axes, stages, states, and finite vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical finite enumeration of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enables summation over every axis index.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the sum of the m axis coefficients and numerous norm or Fourier sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each unqualified finite sum or product range over all relevant indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-addition operation selected by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At the target it is ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-division operation selected by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At the target it is ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-multiplication operation selected by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At the target it is ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The power operation selected by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets epsilon raised to the natural power 2.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation selected by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses nonnegativity, epsilon <= radius, and the final error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict less-than relation selected by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses positivity of epsilon, radius, and the exact-output norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number power operation induced by a monoid.

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies exact negation of the second real product in floating complex multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary negation on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in subtraction, absolute value, and floating complex multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: RingEquiv.toEquiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying bijective equivalence of a ring equivalence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It converts the canonical Fin n to ZMod n correspondence into an enumeration equivalence for floating summation.

dependency_coverage.name: ZMod.finEquiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: For nonzero n, the canonical ring equivalence between Fin n with modular arithmetic and ZMod n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the order in which residues are enumerated by the floating summation routine.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pi
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard real constant pi.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the exact angles 2 pi val(j)/q supplied to floating sine and cosine.

dependency_coverage.name: ZMod.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical natural representative of a modular residue for positive modulus; for modulus zero the definition uses integer absolute value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only positive moduli occur here, so it selects the representative in 0 through q-1 for numerical root angles.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.zero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the recursion base and the index of the computed output state.

binders: A natural number m with NeZero m, so m != 0 and hence there is at least one axis.
A certified m-axis transform plan plan. Write its axis orders as n_i > 0 and its one-dimensional plans as P_i for i in Fin m.
A computation family family for plan and gamma, containing a common complex input tensor x, a floating model for every positive epsilon, and a corresponding computation run.
A certificate axisBounds of uniform per-axis local error bounds for that family.
A premise hexactOutput asserting that the normalized norm of the exact full transform is strictly positive.
hypotheses: The family structure entails gamma >= 0, model_epsilon.epsilon = epsilon, model_epsilon.gamma = gamma, and a common input x for every run.
Each primitive model satisfies the exact error representations for flAdd, flMul, flSin, and flCos described in D053, with perturbation magnitudes at most 1.
The plan certifies exact partial-transform norm scaling: nu(F_k z) = sqrt(N_k) nu(z) for every tensor z and k <= m.
The axisBounds certificate supplies c_i >= 0 and r_0 > 0 such that nu(F_i d_i) <= epsilon B_i(gamma) nu(F_(i+1) z_(i+1)) + c_i epsilon^2 for every 0 < epsilon <= r_0 and every axis i.
For the exact output y = F_m(x), nu(y) > 0.
conclusions: There exists a real secondOrderCoeff C with C >= 0.
After choosing C, there exists a real radius r with r > 0.
For every positive real epsilon with epsilon <= r, nu(computed_epsilon - y) / nu(y) <= epsilon times sum over i in Fin m of B_i(gamma), plus C epsilon^2.
mathematical_definitions: Let I = product over i in Fin m of ZMod(n_i), and let N = product_i n_i. Inputs and outputs are functions I -> Complex.
For a tensor z, nu(z) = sqrt(sum over a in I of |z(a)|^2) / sqrt(N).

Let chi_q denote the supplied standard complex additive character on ZMod(q). The exact transform along axis i is (T_i z)(a) = sum over j in ZMod(n_i) of chi_(n_i)(j a_i) z(a with coordinate i replaced by j).
Define F_0(z) = z and F_(k+1)(z) = F_k(T_k z). Thus the exact full output is y = F_m(x).

For positive epsilon, let z_m(epsilon) = x and let z_i(epsilon) be obtained from z_(i+1)(epsilon) by the floating one-dimensional plan for axis i; equivalently these are the run's computed states. The computed output is z_0(epsilon).

Each floating one-dimensional plan folds its stages in increasing order and applies its final permutation. A floating stage performs its prescribed permutation and block reindexing, computes roots as flCos(2 pi val(j)/q) + i flSin(2 pi val(j)/q), uses the specified floating complex products and left-associated floating sums, and optionally applies a floating twiddle.
The global error tensor is e_epsilon = z_0(epsilon) - y.
For each axis i, its local residual is d_i(epsilon) = z_i(epsilon) - T_i(z_(i+1)(epsilon)). The local bound concerns the propagated residual F_i(d_i(epsilon)).
For a radix q, c(q,gamma) = sqrt(2) when q = 2, c(q,gamma) = 5 when q = 4, and c(q,gamma) = 2 sqrt(q)(q + gamma) otherwise.
If the one-dimensional plan P_i has stage count s_i and stage radices q_(i,t), then B_i(gamma) = sum from t = 0 to s_i-1 of c(q_(i,t),gamma) + (s_i - 1)(3 + 2 gamma), with s_i cast to the reals.

The exact quantity on the left of the final inequality is the relative normalized l2 forward error. Since numerator and denominator use the same factor sqrt(N), it also equals the ordinary l2 error norm divided by the ordinary l2 norm of the exact output.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every nonempty collection of certified transform axes, every nonnegative-gamma family of epsilon-dependent floating computations satisfying the encoded primitive models and per-axis local error bounds, and every input whose exact unnormalized multidimensional Fourier output has nonzero normalized l2 norm, there are constants C >= 0 and r > 0, independent of epsilon, such that every positive epsilon <= r satisfies the relative forward-error estimate nu(computed_epsilon - exact)/nu(exact) <= epsilon sum_i B_i(gamma) + C epsilon^2, with each B_i(gamma) given by the plan's explicit radix- and stage-dependent formula.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem applies only when m is nonzero, so it does not cover a zero-axis transform.
Every axis order, stage radix, block count, and one-dimensional stage count is positive or nonzero through the packaged structures.

Although gamma is universally quantified as a real, an inhabitant of the family type contains a proof gamma >= 0. For gamma < 0 there can be no such family, so that part of the outer universal statement is vacuous.
Likewise, the proposition has content only when certified plan, family, and axisBounds inhabitants exist; it does not prove those structures exist.

axisBounds is not inspected syntactically in the conclusion, but inhabiting its dependent type already supplies the per-axis local bounds. The theorem does not derive those local bounds from the primitive floating model alone.
The exact-output normalized norm must be strictly positive. This excludes zero exact output and ensures that the relative-error denominator is positive.
Only strictly positive epsilon is quantified. The estimate is not asserted at epsilon = 0 or for negative epsilon.
The estimate is local in epsilon: it is asserted only for epsilon <= the existential radius and says nothing for larger epsilon.
The radius is merely required to be positive and has no explicit lower bound or formula. The quadratic coefficient is merely required to be nonnegative and likewise has no explicit formula.
The witnesses C and r may depend on m, plan, gamma, family, axisBounds, and the positive-exact-output premise, but they are chosen before epsilon and therefore cannot depend on epsilon.
The statement is a concrete linear-plus-quadratic inequality, not a formal asymptotic big-O assertion.
The input map in each primitive model is only required to fix the actual run input componentwise; no general error bound is encoded for arbitrary inputs.

The primitive addition model perturbs its two operands separately, multiplication has relative error, and sine and cosine have absolute error bounded using gamma. No underflow, overflow, exceptional values, or finite representability conditions are encoded.
The common local-bound radius is positive, so its positive-epsilon domain is mathematically nonempty; the local hypothesis is not vacuous merely because epsilon must be positive.
The two-constructor LocalDef058 marker stored in a one-dimensional plan carries no stated property and has no observable effect on this proposition.
ambiguities: The packet identifies the Fourier kernel as ZMod.stdAddChar but does not unfold the canonical map ZMod.toCircle, so the explicit exponential sign convention of chi_q cannot be recovered from the supplied definitions. The translation therefore retains the exact supplied abstraction of the standard additive character.

LocalDef058 has two nullary constructors but no supplied semantic interpretation. Its exact logical effect is clear, namely none beyond inhabitation, but the intended meaning of the two alternatives is unspecified.
